title: Constitution DAG - India (constitutional genealogy of power)
subtitle: From the Constitution of India to one street in Kotdwar: instruments, offices, control loops, rights
description: Versioned dump of a constitutional genealogy graph: legal instruments (constitution/amendments/statutes/court decisions), the offices they create and empower (with article-level provisions and subject-matter scopes), the feedback-control web (who impeaches/audits/reviews whom), domain allocations (Seventh Schedule), division-kind grants, and a citizen-rights ledger including demoted and absent rights. Includes the full office-graph context for India with pivot city Kotdwar, Uttarakhand (44/44 offices constitutionally grounded). Every row carries source + confidence. See https://github.com/shaelsrv/constitution-dag for the format spec, portable analyzer, and contribution framework.
